6.279 rsInvalidEmbeddedImageProperty
rsInvalidEmbeddedImageProperty is a critical error that will occur when an Image or
Style.BackgroundImage element specifies that the source of the image is embedded in the RDL but
the name that is specified is not set to the name of an image in the Report.EmbeddedImages element.
